messages:
Maya (Billing): FYI batch-run-2026-05-10 produced several tenant invoices with missing subscription line and one case of invoice_id collision (tenant: beta-co). Example excerpt: compute: 45.00
storage: 5.00
# missing subscription_fee: 200.00
Preview CSV: s3://billing-exports/prod/2026-05-10/beta-co.csv

Jon (FinOps): That's bad. Attach run logs and pricing_service response? Any 404s?

Maya (Billing): Logs uploaded: s3://billing-exports/prod/logs/batch-2026-05-10-4.log. Saw pricing-service 404 for plan lookup: "no_plan for plan_id=starter-legacy" and db warn: "invoice_seq_conflict tenant=beta-co"

Sasha (Eng): Quick hypothesis: pricing DB migration removed legacy_plan entries. Batch workers retried and a retry race allocated same invoice_seq, creating dup id. I'll check pricing-service and sequence allocator.

Ibrahim (Payments): We rolled a small pricing resolver change overnight to canonicalize plan ids. If missing mapping returns 404. I'll rollback to previous behavior while eng patches mapping.

invoicing-bot: Duplicate invoice alert: tenant=beta-co invoice=INV-BC-20260510-007-dup source=batch-run-20260510-4 unresolved

Support (Lina): Customer reported receiving invoice showing compute charged twice and no subscription on email. Holding charge reversal until fix.

Jon (FinOps): Remediation plan: 1) Pause sends for batch-run-2026-05-10 (Maya) 2) Roll back resolver (Ibrahim) 3) Add legacy->canonical map in pricing-service (Sasha) 4) Change seq allocator to use per-tenant atomic INCR + retry guard (Sasha) 5) Regenerate and run reconciliation before resend.

Maya (Billing): Pause applied. Will coordinate reissue once Eng confirms deploy. Will notify customer with holding message.

Sasha (Eng): Hotfix branch created, ETA deploy + smoke tests ~2h. Will update this thread when done.

Maya (Billing): Thanks — leaving thread open.
